mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market discounts accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05 against zero return).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rates below 3.5% indicate a tight labor market supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5% (t-test p > 0.05 against zero return).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous GDP growth > 0.5% and housing starts growth > 0.3% over 3 months signal robust consumer demand, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > 0.5% and HOUST growth > 0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where both GDPC1 and HOUST growth exceed thresholds (t-test p > 0.05 against zero return).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth exceeding 0.2% over 3 months indicates expanding manufacturing output, correlating with rising corporate profits and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when INDPRO growth > 0.2% (t-test p > 0.05 against zero return).

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL growth exceeding 2.0% over 3 months signals inflationary pressure that triggers monetary tightening expectations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL growth > 2.0% (t-test p > 0.05 against zero return).

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales growth exceeding 1.0% over 3 months indicates strong consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through revenue growth momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when RSAFS growth > 1.0% (t-test p > 0.05 against zero return).

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and UNRATE < 3.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy supporting a tight labor market, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market tightness with accommodative policy
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE are below thresholds (t-test p > 0.05 against zero return).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, GDP growth > 1.0% and CPIAUCSL growth > 2.0% over 3 months signal sustained corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > 1.0% and CPIAUCSL growth > 2.0% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when both GDPC1 and CPIAUCSL growth exceed thresholds (t-test p > 0.05 against zero return).
